maddeler.e:
تخترقوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَرِقُوا (taḵtariqū) /tax.ta.ri.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# تُخْتَرَقُوا (tuḵtaraqū) /tux.ta.ra.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
